model_card.inputs: 12 body keypoints per person from YOLO26n-pose + ByteTrack (no faces, no video stored)
model_card.windows: last 2 s resampled to 10 fps, scored every 0.5 s; distances scaled by torso length
model_card.split: GroupKFold by video (AIRTLab cam1/cam2 of one scene kept together); clip score = max window
model_card.threshold: alarm when the smoothed score (alpha 0.6) stays >= 0.75 for 1.0 s; tuned on dataset clips, not yet on own footage
failure_modes: hugs and close contact: 19% of AIRTLab hugs/claps raise an alarm
small or distant people on CCTV: pair features often missing
only one person tracked: pair features unavailable
weapons are not detected as objects; only the body motion is scored

disclosure: Dataset numbers: phone-video sets (RLVS + AIRTLab, 2350 clips, out-of-fold) and a held-out CCTV row (SCF + SCVD, 781 clips, model trained without them). The shipped model also trains on SCF + SCVD; their out-of-fold AUC with CCTV in training is 0.745. Dataset clips are 2-5 s long, so false alarms per camera-hour are not measured yet; live-room numbers come from our own labelled footage. Practice-run lesson: 100% on KTH, zero live until retuned, so we report dataset and live numbers side by side. We detect physical aggression from body motion only; we do not claim verbal or online bullying, weapon recognition, or night vision.
